text: Brooke Rene It definitely does happen: although it is not common, we hear about it at AIC. The form for applying while you are in Israel is mainly intended for people who are already here on another visa who are allowed to apply according to the procedure from within Israel (students, caregivers etc.). Other than deportation, one particular risk/annoyance of applying while here as a tourist is that PIBA is far less likely to grant an intervisa, allowing the foreigner to leave Israel while they wait
